meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Key components of India's balance of payments (DBIE report 875)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments, annual, every line since 1950-51
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 875, fiscal years plotted at April of the first year. The early decades use RBI's older capital-account lines (BO.1 to BO.6, A.1.1, A.1.2, EO.4); the modern lines start in 1990-91. Both are kept as published, never mapped onto each other.
